description: Remove a tag from a task. Requires tagName + (taskId or taskName + optional listName). Only removes the association; the tag remains in the space.

taskId.description: Task ID (preferred). Handles regular and custom IDs.

taskName.description: Task name. Use listName to disambiguate.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: remove_tag_from_task
